name: Montréal short-term rental of a principal residence — seasonal window
description: Montréal allows short-term rental of a principal residence only from 10 June to 10 September; outside that window it is prohibited, and some boroughs prohibit it entirely.

attributes.borough_bans: some boroughs prohibit principal-residence STR entirely (e.g., Lachine, Saint-Laurent, Saint-Léonard per secondary sources)
